source: The systems results are also a useful warning against simplistic speed claims. The paper’s supplemental benchmarks show that quantization/dequantization overhead can dominate smaller matrix multiplications, while larger model dimensions benefit more from ZXNAME0000XZ execution.
zh: 系统结果对于简单化的速度主张也是一个有用的警告。该论文的补充基准表明，量化/反量化开销可以主导较小的矩阵乘法，而较大的模型维度从 ZXNAME0000XZ 执行中受益更多。
